title: Component matrix reorg and auto-layout stabilization for tokenized primitives
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Background: Over the last two quarters we accumulated divergent component variants across buttons, table rows, and chart primitives due to ad-hoc token changes and inconsistent auto-layout constraints. This has led to fragile cross-product usage, frequent regressions during publishes, and inflated Figma file size.

Goal: Reorganize the component matrix (primitives -> atoms -> composed components), normalize auto-layout constraints for responsive spacing, adopt a canonical naming convention for tokenized variants, and run a safe library publish with rollback notes. The work should reduce variant count, improve stacking behavior for compact/responsive states, and unblock SDK parity for updated token keys.

Out of scope: Large visual redesigns, dashboard-specific chart redesigns, or changes to production token values that require product sign-off (those are tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical component folder structure in Figma: Primitives / Atoms / Patterns exists and matches documentation
All button, table-row, and chart-primitive components have consistent auto-layout constraints (padding, min-width rules, hug/fill policies) across size variants
Variant count reduced by at least 30% through dedupe and merging while preserving existing public API (names and variant properties) or providing migration notes
Published library with a single changelog entry and rollback snapshot saved; no blocking regressions reported in first 48h
Design tokens referenced by components use the new semantic naming convention (e.g., ui-xxx instead of raw hex tokens) and match token key map in Confluence
comments: 2026-02-11 - Sofia M: Kickoff meeting notes posted to Confluence, flagged risky chart primitives that rely on nested auto-layout.
2026-02-18 - Ethan B: Completed audit script run (Figma plugin export). Found ~420 component variants across target sets; initial dedupe plan attached.
2026-02-22 - Liam Chen (Engineering): Reviewed planned changes. Ask: keep legacy variant names for 2 weeks for SDK compatibility; provide alias mapping in token mapper.
2026-02-25 - Design review: Agreed to standardize horizontal padding to 12px for compact and 16px for default; agreed to 'hug contents' for height unless min-height required.
2026-03-01 - QA: Ran visual diff for button tokens across primary products; two minor spacing regressions identified and fixed (see PR #378).
2026-03-03 - PM Review (Ava Patel): Confirmed timeline okay for publish window March 12-13. Requested rollback notes and communication plan.
2026-03-05 - Ethan B: Preparing library publish draft. Generated migration mappings: DES-24981-migration-map.csv uploaded to Drive.
notes: Decision: Preserve public-facing variant keys for two weeks post-publish and maintain alias mapping in the token router to avoid SDK breakages.
Trade-off: Full atom-by-atom rename would be cleaner but increases risk to releases; chosen incremental approach balances safety and cleanup velocity.
Follow-ups: Create a small developer-facing guide explaining new auto-layout rules and token naming; track adoption in next cycle.
Rollback plan: Create 'ui-kit-2026.02' snapshot branch in Figma and notify teams via #design-system Slack with rollback instructions and contact owners.
